questions.q: A website checks that a field has not been left empty. Which validation check is this?
questions.why: A presence check makes sure that some data has been entered.

questions.q: A mark must be a whole number from 0 to 100. Which value is abnormal test data?
questions.why: 101 is outside the allowed range and should be rejected; 0 and 100 are extreme valid values.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the temporary variable in a bubble sort swap?
options: To store one value so it is not overwritten when swapping
questions.why: Without Temp, copying one value over the other would lose it.

questions.q: Describe how a linear search works.
questions.model: A linear search starts at the first item and compares each item in turn with the search value. It stops when a match is found or the end of the list is reached.
points: Compares each item in turn with the search item
Stops when found or at end of list
